card.name: Start of a new word after a drug name
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word right after a heading, drug name or abbreviation in drug labels, such as 'pr' in Ipratropium or 'Daily' after a brand name. It also fires on short pieces inside split drug names.

modes.label: Split drug names
modes.description: An early piece of a drug name that has been broken into parts.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS I<<pr>>atropium bromide HFA inhal

modes.label: Word after brand name
modes.description: A dosing word placed right after a brand name in a table or heading.
modes.example: Table 1: TALVEY<< Weekly>> Dosing Schedule Dosing schedule Day

modes.label: Word after section heading
modes.description: The first word after an all-caps section heading.
modes.example: WARNINGS<< Hem>>opoietic depression is the most common
